notes.title: Recommended multiplayer maps for Multiplayer Game Week
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
The Steam Multiplayer Game Week is about to start on September 28th. During the event, "Breaking Box" will be available at a 30% discount, which will last until the end of the event on October 6th.
During the event, the demo will continue to be freely accessible, and you can create up to 20 maps in online rooms to play with other players. (There are no map restrictions when joining rooms with full versions of the game.)
Feel free to invite your friends to play together.

Recommended multiplayer maps:
[h3]①Variety Show Series:[/h3]
When creating a room, select the map and click on the dropdown menu on the left side labeled "Recommendations." Choose the "Variety" tag to access 20 "Variety Show" maps.
There are no skills required, just see who can last the longest without laughing.Friendship 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116301/ef23b5f7446be95176bfe28a00495851a2a1bd9a.png[/img]
[h3]②Cooperation Series:[/h3]
When creating a room, select the map and click on the dropdown menu on the left side labeled "Recommendations." Choose the "Cooperation" tag to access 11 "Friendship Cooperation" maps.
The Friendship Cooperation series supports 2 to 8 players for cooperative online play. It is recommended to enable voice chat during multiplayer sessions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116301/9b4258306b2cfcb69854577b7b95dd86dfbe61ad.png[/img]
[h3]③JUST UP:[/h3]
When creating a room, the default first map in the list is "JUST UP"
The map has a height of 1000 meters, and it may take some time to load, so please be patient. 
The height of your teammates will be displayed on the right side of the screen.
There are also hidden items in the map, so please avoid hurting your fellow players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116301/cc8af6e31bfc5c7278f0b4bbc94d85bfab6e3986.png[/img]
[h3] ④Jump Series:[/h3]
When creating a room, select the map and click on the dropdown menu on the left side labeled "Recommendations." Choose the "Rankings" tag to access the maps for bouncing fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116301/cff69c919bc2cab6a0ed1c33d2fdeccf089ca21e.png[/img]
[h3]⑤Other Brawl Modes:[/h3]
When creating a new room, you can select the "Variety Mode" and "Less Mistakes Mode" tags in the dropdown menu on the left side under "Game Modes" to access different maps for enjoyable gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116301/75bd342563b0cb7ea0552b8c42d8624d4b3f7676.png[/img]
Wishing you a pleasant gaming experience!

notes.title: New Multiplayer Maps for "Breaking Box"
notes.notes:
This month, we have added 20 new official multiplayer maps.
Variety Show (10-19) maps: These maps focus on a no-skills challenge, testing who can last the longest.
Friendship Co-op (01-10) maps: These maps support 2 to 8 players for cooperative online play, with each map designed to be completed within 15 to 30 minutes.
To access the new maps, simply go to the multiplayer section on the main menu, create a room, and choose the recommended maps from the dropdown list under the Variety Show and Friendship Co-op sections.
We welcome you to invite your friends and enjoy the new maps together.
In addition, the spin-off game "Breaking Box: Walk!" is now available for purchase at a price of 2$, with a special launch week discount of 20% off, making it only 1.6$.
To celebrate the game's release, we will also be hosting a limited-time discount promotion from September 14th to September 21st:

●"Incredible Dream Butterfly" at a 60% discount.

*"Breaking Box" will be offering a discount during the Steamchina Appreciation Festival, starting on September 22nd.

We hope that our games will provide you with a delightful gaming experience!

notes.title: Breaking Box Demo has been released
notes.notes:
In order to let more players experience the joy of Breaking Box, we have released the Demo. 
Through the Demo version, you will be able to experience some of the content within the game. 
However, certain features such as skins, loot boxes, leaderboards, and endless mode will not be available in this version.
You will have the opportunity to play through the first area of the World Challenge, which consists of 10 levels, providing you with an enjoyable gaming experience. 
Additionally, you will be able to create up to 20 maps in multiplayer rooms and enjoy playing with other players (joining other players' rooms will not have any map restrictions).
The Demo version also includes an editor feature, allowing you to unleash your creativity and create your own maps. 
However, uploading custom maps will not be possible in this version.
We wish you a pleasant gaming experience!

notes.title: Solution for Known Bug
notes.notes: When experiencing abnormal display with 4K resolution, please switch the resolution to 1080p in the Windows system settings, run the game, and then switch back to 4K resolution. This will allow the game to run properly.

notes.title: The game "Breaking Box" is now available for purchase
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that our game "Breaking Box," developed by 
Dotoyou Games, has finally been released! 
The game is priced at $9.9, with a launch week discount of $7.92.

The map level editor has been unlocked, with support for 60,000 tiles! 
Utilizing the editor, we have created the "JUST UP" map for everyone to challenge!
If you're looking for a relaxed and casual experience, you can choose the World Mode to conquer various levels! 
But if you're up for an endless adventure, the Endless Challenge mode awaits you!
Of course, you can unleash your creativity and use the editor to create your very own maps! (Once your uploaded maps pass the review process, they can be selected in multiplayer rooms, and high-quality maps will be included in the Endless Challenge mode and leaderboard.)
Create rooms and enjoy a joyful time together with friends in multiplayer mode!
————————————————————
Here is a message from the developers to the players:
Dotoyou Game has come a long way over the past ten years, and as a small team of a dozen people, this is our first multiplayer game.
During the four years of development, we encountered many difficulties. 
We went through crashes, lagging, disappearing characters, and even faced challenges with testing, finding a publisher, and marketing. 
However, seeing the once laggy levels become smooth, witnessing strange physics and glitches normalize, and watching the initially crude little box grow into the adorable big box it is today, we are finally able to introduce Breaking Box to all of you. We can finally deliver something to ourselves and the patient players who have been waiting.
We acknowledge that the game still has many flaws and bugs. 
We hope that you can see the highlights of Box Splitting and we will continue to improve the game's experience.
To that end, we will arrange version updates as soon as possible. 
The map module feature is currently under development, allowing multiple maps to be combined into one, and it will be released once the corresponding UI is complete. 
We will also optimize the friend adding process in multiplayer rooms to provide a better team experience for players. 
The World Mode will continue to be updated, bringing more surprises for everyone. Stay tuned!
If you have any suggestions, please feel free to let us know!
Thank you!

notes.title: Breaking Box Q&A
notes.notes:
The interactive game "Breaking Box" that allow players to create game maps, will be available for an early access version on Steam in just 1 day (PST: 2023/8/10 19:00)! 
The game is priced at $9.9, with a launch week discount of $7.92.

To help players understand the game, here is the official Q&A:

Q: When will Breaking Box release?
A: The game will be released on
PST: 2023/8/10 19:00
PDT: 2023/8/10 18:00

Q: What can i do in the single-player mode and how long is corresponding game duration?
A: The current version features an JUST UP mode with hard difficulty, taking approximately 1 hour to complete. It also includes a world mode with 100 easy levels, which can be completed in about 3 to 5 hours. Additionally, there is an endless challenge mode with 400+ levels, offering random difficulty and providing over 10 hours of gameplay.

Q: What should I do if I get stuck in the endless challenge mode?
A: On the left-side collapsible panel in the main interface, click on the leaderboard and map ranking. Search for maps where players have successfully completed the challenging levels, and watch their recorded gameplay. (A skip level mechanism may be implemented in the future.)

Q: Can the JUST UP mode be played in multiplayer?
A: Yes, it can be played in multiplayer. When selecting maps in the multiplayer room, search for the keyword "1vz6uafef" and choose a map to play. However, completion rewards can only be obtained through single-player challenges in the main interface.

Q: How can I add game friends?
A: In the world chat, click on a player's avatar to follow them. After following, you can invite them to join your room. You can also see recently played players in the friend function on the left-side collapsible panel in the main interface. Click on follow to invite them to your room. (Friend and room functions will be further optimized after the game is launched.)

Q: How do I upload maps?
A: When you meet the conditions for map upload , click on the upload map button and wait for the map to be reviewed. Players will receive a notification after the review process, and once approved, the map can be selected in multiplayer rooms. High-quality maps will be included in the endless challenge mode and leaderboard!

Q: What should I do if I encounter any issues or want to report bugs?
A: You can provide feedback on the Steam community.
